LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 12.3.1 PHRASAL VERBS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are phrasal verbs different from other verbs?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify phrasal verbs formed from break, hang, run and turn in texts
2. use the given phrasal verbs in sentences of their own
3. value the importance of using phrasal verbs in spoken and written communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 12.3.1 PHRASAL VERBS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify phrasal verbs formed from break, hang, run and turn in texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use the given phrasal verbs in sentences of their own
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. value the importance of using phrasal verbs in spoken and written communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are phrasal verbs different from other verbs?
2. Why is it important to learn meanings of phrasal verbs?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify phrasal verbs formed from break, hang, run and turn in texts
2. use the given phrasal verbs in sentences of their own
3. value the importance of using phrasal verbs in spoken and written communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
